SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Specifies whether the quantity of financial instrument is to be delivered or received.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Financial instrument representing a sum of rights of the investor vis-a-vis the issuer.

CollateralMovement.name: Collateral Movement
CollateralMovement.definition: Indicates whether the financial instrument is delivered/received as collateral or as a loan.

ClientSecuritiesMovementIdentification.name: Client Securities Movement Identification
ClientSecuritiesMovementIdentification.definition: Reference assigned by the party A to the financial instrument movement.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderSecuritiesMo.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Securities Movement Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderSecuritiesMo.definition: Reference assigned by the triparty agent to the financial instrument movement.
